parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0, p1) of location distributions for blue and red at nodes n0–n3. Use origins and times as supplied: copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are hypothetical branches, not executed events. Current estimates (panel p0): n0 — blue peak at cell (0,1) (high peak probability), red peak at (0,3); n1 and n2 — uniform distributions for both roles; n3 — blue peak at (1,2), red peak at (0,1). Panel p1 current matches p0 at n0–n2 but shows a uniform distribution at n3. Conditional command records differ mainly at p1:n3: k0 keeps n3 uniform; k1 concentrates blue on the top-right 2×2 block and red on the top-left 2×2 block; k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1). In panel p0 the candidate commands preserve the same peak cells as the current records (numeric values vary slightly).
